LESSON: SIGN READING 2.2.2 SIGN READING POSTURE

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP1
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.2: Sign Reading 2.2.2 Sign Reading posture
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Sign Reading 2.2.2 Sign Reading posture, part of Strand 2 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP1 General.

Key inquiry question: Which is the appropriate reading posture? 2. Why do we need to sit upright as we read?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Sign Reading 2.2.2 Sign Reading posture together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
20

● Communication and collaboration: Speaking and signing skills as learner sing and sign songs on correct reading posture as they

demonstrate.

● Creativity and Imagination: networking skill as learner undertakes group activities during peer assessment on correct reading

posture.

Values:
● Love: Hospitability as the learner together with another demonstrates right sitting posture while doing peer assessment to give

one another feedback.

● Unity: Non-discrimination as the learners work together giving one another feedback on how to use the right reading posture.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Health education as the learner learns proper sitting posture while reading that helps avoid unnecessary straining of body parts that

could bring about health issues.

Link to other Learning Areas:

Learner relates appropriate sitting posture in all the learning areas

Suggested Learning Resources: assistive devices fitted with appropriate technology such as hearing aids and amplifiers,books,

magazines, audio visual clips with signed songs, relevant digital devices
